tools.name: account_whoami
tools.description: Return the current Create Web Page account context. Use this to check whether the user is authenticated or using an anonymous expiring demo.

tools.name: page_intake_start
tools.description: Optional first step for a vague page request (e.g. 'make me a website for my barbershop'). Returns at most one round of questions to ask together: the name, the main visitor action AND where it goes (WhatsApp number with country code, booking/order link, phone or address), and must-have facts. Skip

tools.name: page_onboarding_start
tools.description: Guided visual setup (category, layout, palette, primary action) that does NOT create a page. Use it ONLY when the user explicitly wants to choose the style/layout step by step; for normal requests call page_create_from_brief (asking at most one round of questions first). IMPORTANT: this flow is STAT

tools.name: page_onboarding_update
tools.description: Validate onboarding selections and return the remaining checklist. STATELESS: it does not remember previous calls, so every call must include the FULL accumulated selection (mainCategory, subCategory, layout, palette, primaryAction) plus all knownFields (name, description, action destination, etc.)

tools.name: source_import
tools.description: Fetch a public website URL and extract a structured brief with business name, description, contact links, and suggested page blocks. Only works with public HTTP/HTTPS pages. Does not bypass login, CAPTCHA, or paywalls. Returns extracted fields and suggestedBlocks for use with page_create_from_brief.

tools.name: page_create
tools.description: Low-level/legacy: create a blank link-in-bio scaffold from a style preset (title, displayName, preset or 'auto'). tools.name: page_create_from_brief
tools.description: The main tool for creating a page. tools.name: block_add
tools.description: Append a new content block to a link-in-bio page. The block must match one of the 14 allowed types (link, social_row, whatsapp, phone_call, email_contact, image, gallery, video_embed, text, map_embed, product_card, lead_form, reviews, save_contact) with that type's strict props. tools.name: layouts_list
tools.description: List supported page layouts. Currently ships link_in_bio only.

tools.name: presets_list
tools.description: List the 12 curated style presets (theme + starter blocks) for link-in-bio. Use to offer the user a choice or to confirm a preset:auto selection.

tools.name: page_get
tools.description: Read a landing page draft, including its latest content JSON. For anonymous demo pages, include the editToken.

tools.name: media_upload
tools.description: Add an image to a page. tools.name: media_upload_link_create
tools.description: Get an upload link for a photo on the user's own device (phone/computer) — the right tool whenever the image is not already at a public URL. tools.name: media_attach
tools.description: Attach a ready media asset to the page. placement determines where: avatar (header), block_image (image inside a specific block — requires blockId), gallery_item (appended to a gallery — optional blockId targets a specific gallery; otherwise the first one is used), background (theme background).

tools.name: media_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a media asset and remove all references to it from the page content.

tools.name: page_claim
tools.description: Claim an anonymous demo page into an AUTHENTICATED account. tools.name: account_pages_list
tools.description: List landing pages saved to the signed-in account. Safe to call without sign-in: an anonymous chat gets ok=true, authenticated=false and an empty list (not an error) because it has no saved pages — then create the page directly with page_create_from_brief. tools.name: account_page_manage
tools.description: Read a claimed account page without requiring an editToken. Use after OAuth when the user wants to manage a durable website.

tools.name: page_header_update
tools.description: Update the link-in-bio page header: displayName, bio, verified checkmark, business-card display style ("photo_hero" large top photo or "avatar"), a short role label (e.g. "Barber · Madrid"), labelPosition, and the header photo (photoUrl; null removes it). tools.name: page_theme_update
tools.description: Apply a partial theme patch. Theme fields are enum-constrained (button variant/radius/shadow, font family/weight, density, icon_size). tools.name: page_meta_update

tools.name: page_preview
tools.description: Return the current preview URL for a page. You usually do not need this: page_create and page_create_from_brief already return a ready-to-open previewUrl. For an anonymous demo page you must pass the editToken from the create result; calling this with pageId alone fails.

tools.name: page_publish
tools.description: Publish the latest page revision. Call this only when the user's latest message explicitly asks to publish, make the page live, or get a public share link. tools.name: page_unpublish
tools.description: Remove a published landing page from public availability while keeping its draft and revision history.

tools.description: Patch one content block by stable blockId. Provide a props patch (merged into existing props) and/or a new type. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account_whoami, source_import, page_create, page_create_from_brief, media_upload_link_create, page_claim, account_pages_list, page_preview, page_publish · Private data: source_import, page_create_from_brief, media_upload · Public sink: page_create, page_create_from_brief, block_add, media_upload, media_upload_link_create, page_claim, page_header_update, page_theme_update, page_meta_update, page_publish, block_update, block_delete, block_reorder · Destructive: media_delete, page_unpublish, block_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account_whoami, source_import, page_create, page_create_from_brief, media_upload_link_create, page_claim, account_pages_list, page_preview, page_publish · Private data: source_import, page_create_from_brief, media_upload · Public sink: page_create, page_create_from_brief, block_add, media_upload, media_upload_link_create, page_claim, page_header_update, page_theme_update, page_meta_update, page_publish, block_update, block_delete, block_reorder · Destructive: media_delete, page_unpublish, block_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
